jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) Institute for Cardiogenetics 1 (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Das Universitätsklinikum Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) verbindet internationale Spitzenforschung mit interdisziplinärer Krankenversorgung. Wir sind einziger Maximalversorger und größter Arbeitgeber des Landes. Unsere rund 17.500 Mitarbeitenden stellen eine höchst individuelle Versorgung sicher - unverzichtbar für die Menschen in Schleswig-Holstein.Institute of CardiogeneticsThe position is based at the Institute of Cardiogenetics at the UKSH. The institute brings together experts in life science, bioinformatics, and cardiovascular medicine to advance the understanding of molecular mechanisms underlying heart disease and to translate these insights into preclinical approaches. The work will be carried out within the framework of the Precision Medicine in Chronic Inflammation (PMI) https://www.precisionmedicine.de/de/ueber-den-cluster, and in close collaboration with the Clinic of Dermatology at the USKH Campus Lübeck.Start in our teamWe are looking for a highly motivated person to join our dynamic interdisciplinary team. You will contribute to ambitious, collaborative projects focused primarily on inflammatory disease research. Join our team and support us from January 1st, 2027, initially limites for three years as Postdoctoral Researcher.What do we offer:- Salary payment in accordance to remuneration group E13 TV-L, based on a fixed-term contract for 3 years- Full-time employment, currently 38.5 hours/ week. Part-time employment may be compatible within the framework of certain working time models- Stimulating environment and interdisciplinary research team- Participation in the "PMI Cluster of Excellence - DFG EXC 2167/2" and the German Center of Cardiovascular Research (DZHK)- Discover more exciting employee benefits at UKSH here: Benefits (uksh.de)Your responsibilities:- Apply methods from molecular epidemiology to WGS and scRNA Seq data- In silico annotations of genomics findings- Perform statistical data analysis, data integration, and visualization and contribute to the publication of research findings and research grant applications- Provide support to interdisciplinary team members- Close involvement in the PMI Project "Sex Diversity in CID"Your profile:- A strong background in bioinformatics, computational biology, data sciences, or a related field, with knowledge of biology, and a PhD (or a minimum of 3 yrs experience in the field) is required- Statistical and bioinformatic skills, in particular analysis of human, in vitro, and in vivo omics datasets combined with hands-on experience in experimental validation of genetic and molecular findings- Experience in applying statistical methods from genetic epidemiology- Expertise in Linux/Unix environment, HPC clusters, proficiency in R, Python, and practical knowledge of reproducible workflow systems (e.g. Nextflow, Snakemake) and version control tools is appreciated- Strong communication skills, with a passion for interdisciplinary teamwork, as well as fluency in English; knowledge of German is an advantageWe look forward to receiving your application by 25 November 2026. Please quote the job reference number 29442 in your application.

Company DescriptionOur Transformation JourneyAs METRO.digital evolves, we are reshaping the way we work through our Target Operating Model (TOM).TOM describes the desired state of our organization’s operational capabilities and functions. It provides a vision for the future state of the business, explaining how the company needs to operate to deliver its strategy and achieve its business goals efficiently. The TOM outlines how various elements like processes, technology, governance, and people should interconnect and interact to deliver value. It serves as a roadmap for implementing organizational change and transformation.About the TeamWe think globally and act locally. Since October 1, our international IT organization has been operating under the new Target Operating Model (TOM). This international IT organization, spanning 21 countries and multiple companies, is the dedicated scope of the International People Strategist. As part of our international People & Culture team, you will establish and embed end-to-end people processes for this IT organization, build trusted relationships with its leaders and local P&C teams, and develop an effective cross-country network. You will connect global frameworks with the specific requirements of the international IT organization and its country organizations, contributing across the full spectrum of People & Culture work, from hands-on operational implementation to strategic initiatives.Beyond day-to-day tasks, our work creates stability, builds trust, and strengthens our culture, enabling our people to thrive and our business to grow.How you will make an impact?As People Strategist for International IT, you are the dedicated P&C Business Partner for our international IT organization, across all METRO countries and companies. Your scope covers the leaders, employees, and organizational units within this international IT organization. You play a key role in embedding the new Target Operating Model by establishing and continuously improving People & Culture processes throughout the employee lifecycle, building trusted relationships, and developing an effective network across the IT organization, its countries, companies, and functions. The role combines hands-on operational work, process ownership, cross-functional coordination, and strategic People & Culture contributions for the international IT organization. Working closely with its leaders, local P&C teams, and Corporate expert functions such as Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, and Learning, you translate global approaches into practical, consistent, and locally compliant solutions for the IT organization.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Establish and embed the People & Culture processes, relationships, networks, and ways of working required to make the new Target Operating Model effective within the international IT organization;- Design, establish, implement, and continuously improve People & Culture processes across the entire employee lifecycle for the international IT organization, ensuring clear ownership and effective execution;- Provide hands-on operational support as well as conceptual and strategic People & Culture contributions to the leaders, employees, and organizational units within the international IT organization, depending on business and organizational needs;- Partner with P&C country functions to translate international frameworks into practical solutions for the international IT organization that reflect local business needs, legal requirements, and organizational maturity;- Coordinate closely with Corporate People & Culture expert functions, including Compensation & Benefits, Recruiting, Talent Development, Learning, and other relevant teams, to deliver integrated solutions for the international IT organization;- Support leaders within the international IT organization and their local P&C teams on organizational design, workforce planning, talent, performance, succession, engagement, and employee relations, while enabling appropriate local ownership;- Drive the consistent implementation of global People & Culture frameworks across the international IT organization and facilitate alignment among its countries, companies, functions, and matrix structures;- Use people data, KPIs, and business insights from the international IT organization to identify trends, monitor process effectiveness, assess risks, and derive actionable improvements;- Support organizational change and culture initiatives within the international IT organization and contribute to a consistent employee and manager experience across its countries and companies;- Ensure that People & Culture solutions for the international IT organization comply with applicable labor laws, co-determination requirements, internal policies, and governance standards, in collaboration with the relevant local and Corporate stakeholders.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Law, or a related field;- At least 5 years of relevant HR experience, including several years as an HR Business Partner in an international or matrix organization;- Demonstrated experience advising senior leaders and translating business priorities into pragmatic people solutions;- Strong knowledge of German labor law and employee relations; experience working across additional jurisdictions is an advantage;- Proven capability in organizational design, workforce planning, talent and performance management, and change management;- Confidence working with people data, KPIs, and HRIS/HCM systems to support evidence-based decisions;- Strong business acumen, stakeholder management, consulting, and coaching skills, with the ability to influence across cultures and organizational boundaries;- Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex change;- Very good fluency in English (written and verbal), German preferred;- Additional languages are an advantage;- Willingness to collaborate across time zones and travel internationally when required.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid jobs.description: This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. The role addresses the need for focused commercial management due to an expanding product portfolio, including electric motors and maritime applications, and increasing complexity in external projects with international clients. To meet these business objectives, the role is structured around three core areas: comprehensive Commercial Offer and Bid Management for all projects, rigorous Sales Process and Financial Governance using tools like Salesforce and PATAC, and proactive Stakeholder and Risk Management to navigate complex international requirements and ensure seamless collaboration between technical and commercial teams. Given the focus on these areas, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in commercial sales and contract management within an industrial manufacturing context. A proven ability to manage complex international projects, including financial calculations and risk mitigation, is essential for success in this role.How You’ll Make an Impact- Lead the development and preparation of commercial offers for all internal and external generator, electric motor, and maritime application projects originating from the Erfurt factory.- Structure, draft, and negotiate complex sales contracts, amendments, and bid documents in collaboration with technical sales, legal, and business management teams.- Manage the end-to-end bid and proposal process, ensuring all submissions are competitive, compliant, and aligned with strategic business objectives.- Develop and implement pricing strategies and perform detailed cost calculations for all tenders and proposals.- Manage all commercial sales activities and pipeline information within Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and generating regular sales reports.- Execute and oversee core commercial processes, including the Project Approval and Tender Approval Committee (PATAC) workflow, bond applications, and financial clearances.- Ensure the fulfillment of contractual financial obligations, coordinating with finance on topics such as invoicing and payment terms.- Continuously improve commercial sales processes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risks.- Serve as the primary commercial liaison for key external clients, managing complex requirements related to international tax issues, permanent establishment (PE) setup, and local installation services.- Collaborate closely with the technical sales team to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and to prevent execution problems on complex projects.- Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, financial, and contractual risks throughout the entire sales cycle.- Coach and delegate work to lower-level professionals, acting as a subject matter expert for commercial sales processes.What You Bring- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.- Several years of experience in a senior commercial sales, contract management, or bid management role, preferably within the power jobs.description: Im Geschäftsbereich Mobilität suchen wir engagierte Talente, die den Weg für eine sichere, nachhaltige und smarte Mobilität von morgen ebnen möchten und damit Wegbereiter einer besseren Mobilität werden. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung der Verkehrssicherheit und Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für alle Verkehrssysteme und -träger – von der Straße über die Schiene bis zur Luft. support Type Approval and homologation by translating Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI and regulatory requirements—e.g., UN R171/DCAS—into practical guidance.- Deliver consultancy and support business acquisition through customer workshops, pre-sales, technical interviews, bid support, gap analyses, document reviews, pre-assessments and project reviews; contribute to service development for automated driving and AI-enabled vehicle systems.- Coordinate international projects and harmonise technical delivery across regions and business units globally; connect Functional Safety, SOTIF, AI, cybersecurity, testing, certification and Type Approval at subject and team level while strengthening internal capabilities through guidance, training and knowledge sharing.Experience und further qualifications- Senior automotive safety expert with hands-on experience in safety-critical E/E systems, embedded software, ADAS/AD, simulation-based verification, validation and testing, complemented by a background in software development, systems engineering, architecture and technical project delivery- Extensive Functional Safety expertise under ISO 26262/8800, including safety lifecycle, HARA, ASIL, ASPICE, safety concepts, safety analyses and safety case documentation; experienced with FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, DFA, STPA and comparable methods- Sound knowledge of SOTIF according to ISO 21448 and its interaction with Functional Safety for perception-based and data-driven functions; familiarity with Type Approval, homologation, software update management and automotive cybersecurity is beneficial- Strong understanding of automotive AI and machine-learning applications, including perception, sensor fusion, prediction, planning, decision-making, monitoring and fallback; able to assess systems with limited explainability and incomplete scenario coverage- Broad knowledge of automotive development processes, including requirements engineering, configuration and change management, validation planning, tool qualification and evidence management; experienced in audits, assessments, confirmation reviews and independent technical evaluations- Consulting, pre-sales, business acquisition and bid-process experience, combined with strong analytical judgement, a structured auditor mindset, customer orientation and excellent communication skills; fluent in German and English, with willingness to travel internationally.
